texts.about_this_item: Dog Fest rabbit ears with chicken, a treat for puppies (90 g). A combination of chewy rabbit ears and tender chicken meat creates a unique puppy treat: it lets your dog enjoy the taste of farm-fresh chicken and have a great time chewing on tender, yet chewy ears. Guaranteed analysis: crude protein 35%, crude fat 3%, crude fibre 0.2%, crude ash 4.5%, moisture 18%.
